summary: Iteration 3: BENOTEK-BAU logo+favicon+calc-to-contact-form passthrough. All features verified end-to-end. Backend POST /api/contact accepts mixed services array (munkadij/extras/percent/fixed/custom) with total_min/total_max — returned echoed payload contains the full ServiceLineItem list with correct categories and values. Favicon.svg served at /favicon.svg (200, image/svg+xml, valid SVG markup). Frontend: SVG brand-logo (data-testid='brand-logo') renders once in header and once in footer (replacing previous 'B' div). favicon link present in <head> and resolves correctly. Services calculator calc-cta navigates to /kapcsolat with location.state={sqm,calcItems}; sqm is prefilled, services-panel expanded, tapadohid checkbox preset to checked. Toggle-services-panel button collapses/expands the panel body. Bidirectional sync between form-sqm and form-qty-cementes works (form→200 sets cementes qty=200; cementes qty=150 sets form sqm=150). Submission network payload contains services[] with category fields plus total_min/total_max (verified: cementes munkadij, tapadohid extras, lepcsohaz percent). Success state shown after submit; 'Új üzenet küldése' resets form sqm to empty. Fresh load of /kapcsolat (no state) keeps services-panel collapsed by default.

Fresh navigation to /kapcsolat (no SPA state): services-panel exists but body collapsed by default (correct)
Same brand-logo SVG is used in /favicon.svg (B with notch + plaster stripes)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py build_html_email() still references hardcoded '3 500 Ft/m² átlagáron' average — with the new range pricing model + per-service breakdown via build_services_html(), this avg line is mildly redundant. Non-blocking.

ContactSubmission.total_price still computed from PRICE_PER_SQM (3500) but the user-visible total in the email body now comes from total_min/total_max in the services table; consider deprecating total_price or aligning naming. Non-blocking.

Contact.jsx setSvcChecked: when checking a non-cementes m²-unit rate row whose previous qty is 0, it inherits services.cementes.qty as fallback rather than form.square_meters. Works correctly in current flow but slightly inconsistent with Services.jsx pattern.
Float precision: total_min sent as 442500.00000000006 (JS arithmetic). Backend accepts via float field; consider rounding on the frontend before submit for cleaner emails.
Pydantic v2 deprecation: @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated (consider lifespan). Non-blocking, carried over from prior iteration.
seed_data_creation: 1 contact submission created in DB via curl (TEST_Multi) + 1 via frontend submit (TEST Frontend). Existing TEST_ records from prior iterations remain. Harmless.
